mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ground ( manager_id, name, address, address_detail, region, size_info, is_indoor, grass_type, parking_type, has_shower, has_lights, has_shoes_rental, has_ball_rental, price_per_hour, notice, created_at ) VALUES ( #{managerId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{addressDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{region, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sizeInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{isIndoor}, 0), NVL(#{grassType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '인조잔디'), NVL(#{parkingType}, 0), NVL(#{hasShower}, 0), NVL(#{hasLights}, 1), NVL(#{hasShoesRental}, 0), NVL(#{hasBallRental}, 0), NVL(#{pricePerHour}, 0), #{notice, jdbcType=CLOB}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE ground SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, region = #{region, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, size_info = #{sizeInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_indoor = NVL(#{isIndoor}, is_indoor), grass_type = NVL(#{grassType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, grass_type), parking_type = NVL(#{parkingType}, parking_type), has_shower = NVL(#{hasShower}, has_shower), has_lights = NVL(#{hasLights}, has_lights), has_shoes_rental = NVL(#{hasShoesRental}, has_shoes_rental), has_ball_rental = NVL(#{hasBallRental}, has_ball_rental), price_per_hour = NVL(#{pricePerHour}, price_per_hour), notice = #{notice, jdbcType=CLOB} WHERE ground_id = #{groundId} AND manager_id = #{managerId}
mapper.select: SELECT ground_id AS groundId, manager_id AS managerId, name, address, address_detail AS addressDetail, region, size_info AS sizeInfo, is_indoor AS isIndoor, grass_type AS grassType, parking_type AS parkingType, has_shower AS hasShower, has_lights AS hasLights, has_shoes_rental AS hasShoesRental, has_ball_rental AS hasBallRental, price_per_hour AS pricePerHour, notice, created_at AS createdAt FROM ground WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} ORDER BY ground_id DESC

SELECT ground_id AS groundId, manager_id AS managerId, name, address, address_detail AS addressDetail, region, size_info AS sizeInfo, is_indoor AS isIndoor, grass_type AS grassType, parking_type AS parkingType, has_shower AS hasShower, has_lights AS hasLights, has_shoes_rental AS hasShoesRental, has_ball_rental AS hasBallRental, price_per_hour AS pricePerHour, notice, created_at AS createdAt FROM ground WHERE ground_id = #{groundId}
